top_concerns: TD-error framing is metaphorical; no TD computation, and TD vs MC comparison is confounded by extra feedbacker inputs (user goal, API calls) and replay
Baselines (APO/GPO/MC) are not given equal information, history access, or optimisation budget; TextGrad is a re-implementation; no multi-turn agent optimiser baselines
No variances/seeds/CIs in Tables 1-2; differences among methods are often within noise; selection on validation may bias results
Simulated-user and rule-based evaluation only; no real-user or cross-simulator test; medical QA human eval is small, unreported agreement, and comparison to HuatuoGPT-II is confounded by base model
Efficiency/latency claims over self-refine pipelines are not measured; long-term planning not directly tested
